decisions.reason: As a newly launched product in a large established machinery firm’s core printing portfolio, it is still too early to judge against aspiration levels and available organisational slack supports keeping it while market feedback accumulates.

This software module directly extends the firm’s existing inline variable-data printing offer, so its strategic fit and low resource burden make withdrawal within a year unlikely absent clear failure signals.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces is a close adjacent application for the firm, and with only one year on the market a large German manufacturer would typically continue it unless performance clearly fell below aspirations.
